We look forward to welcoming you in Hong Kong on **Tuesday night, 1 July 2025**! The programme below outlines the core conference activities, including **keynotes, paper sessions**, and our experimental **Catalytic Interfaces** track.

_Note: This schedule is tentative and may be updated. Social event details (tours, Shenzhen day trip, Junk Boat Party) will be announced soon. Tickets for these will be sold separately._
